title: Compare documents by meaning
summary: List the substantive differences between two versions of a document.

inputs.before: Rent is $400 per week, due on Mondays. Pets are not allowed. The lease runs for 12 months.
inputs.after: Rent is $450 per week, due on Mondays. Pets are allowed with approval. The lease runs for twelve months.
The lease runs for twelve months.

sections.use: See what changed in substance between two versions of a contract, policy or document. Pair it with compare_texts for the literal line-by-line diff.
sections.exclusions: Not a line diff: wording-only changes are not listed.
sections.limitations: Needs a model context of at least 32,768 tokens (prompt, input, one repair and 6,144 output tokens). Results are model output: review them. Each version up to 20,000 characters; up to 30 differences.
sections.missing_data: Equivalent versions give an empty list and a summary saying so.
sections.effects: Sends its inputs to the model of its role (fast by default) and returns the result for review. With unrestricted ports and unrestricted data, that model may be remote; the Add dialog shows the destination. Label inputs Local only to keep them on this machine.
sections.failures: If the reply does not meet the output contract after two repairs, the step fails with located issues. A context or token limit is reported as such; shorten the input or use a larger context.

outputs.differences: Each difference: topic, before, after and significance (minor or material).
outputs.summary: A short summary of the changes.
